stemMarkdown: Walking at 3 km/h a student reaches school 20 minutes late, and walking at 4 km/h he reaches 15 minutes early. Find the distance (in km) to the school. (Round to 4 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: The two journeys differ in time by $20 + 15 = 35$ minutes $= 0.5833$ hours. If the distance is $d$, then $\dfrac{d}{3} - \dfrac{d}{4} = 0.5833$, giving $d = 7.0$ km.
